text:
mira: quick report - roundtripped int4 checkpoint shows deterministic drift on very long prefixes (~70k). short prefixes fine. repro + logs below.

ben: paste the minimal repro command and any failing log lines?

mira: repro:```bash
python tests/longctx_regress.py --model /tmp/llamaX-rt-int4 --baseline /tmp/llamaX-fp16 --prefix tests/longprefixes/chain70k.txt --seed 21 --max-tokens 70000
```
log excerpt:```
[2026-03-21T01:12:05Z] INFO kv_cache: apply_prefill tokens=32768 shard=0
[2026-03-21T01:12:05Z] WARN rope: possible_wrap pos=32768 period=40960
[2026-03-21T01:12:06Z] ERROR kv_verify: expected_idx=32768 got_idx=0 layer=20
```

casey: expected==32768 got==0 suggests a wrap/alias in the kv indexing. Any metadata diffs after the roundtrip?

mira: quick header diff (roundtrip exporter v.s. reference exporter):```
exporter.version: "ref-2026-03" -> "ref-2026-03-rt"
pack.alignment: 0 -> 8
payload.offsets: [0,16384,32768] -> [8,16392,32776]
```
so some layers got an 8B padding inserted.

alex: that 8B shift will change nibble pairing for int4 packed buffers when kernels assume 16B alignment, producing tiny dequant errors. Over many tokens and after RoPE wrap these errors magnify to token divergence.

ben: did you run the loader-strict check?

mira: yes LOADER_STRICT=1 triggers assertion in tests/debug_kv.py:```py
assert layer.kv_buffer.offset % 16 == 0, layer.kv_buffer.offset
```
for offending layers offset == 8.

casey: options: (A) fix serializer to preserve tight packing/alignment (preferred long-term), (B) loader fallback: memcpy into aligned buffer if misaligned (fast to implement), (C) change kernels to support unaligned reads (risky & perf sensitive).

ben: agree with (A)+(B). Casey, can you prototype loader memcpy fallback behind a flag? Measure startup cost.

casey: PoC done. Behavior: if offset%16!=0 we mmap a new aligned region and memcpy payload (then free). Overhead measured ~1.2s for a 28GB artifact on dev machines. I'll open a small PR to rt-loader branch with flag LOADER_ALLOW_UNALIGNED=true.

mira: good. I'll block onboarding of the rt artifact until serializer changes land or loader fallback merged. Also adding longctx_compare 50k prefix test in onboarding CI to catch this.

alex: add a unit in serializer that roundtrip serializes -> reloads -> byte-compare tensor payloads to catch injected padding changes. That should prevent regressions.

perf-bot: scheduled: longctx_regress fuzz run (seeds=10) on rt-int4-fix branch starting 2026-03-21T23:00Z; will report earliest divergence per seed and whether memcpy-fallback removed errors.

mira: thanks all. leaving thread open until perf-bot + CI green. :mag:
